regions.breakdown: 能 (Nō) refers to Noto (能登) Peninsula. 越 (Etsu) refers to Etchū (越中) Province (modern-day Toyama Prefecture). 道 (dō) means 'road' and is commonly used in names of expressways (高速道路 - kōsoku dōro).

where_youd_see_it: You would see this sign on or near the Noetsu Expressway in Japan, indicating the route number and name.
cultural_note: Many Japanese expressways are named by combining characters from the old provincial names or major regions they connect. 'E41' is the route number for this specific expressway.
